domains.name: School Problems
domains.summary: Indicates if the child had school problems including suspensions, truancy, and other unspecified issues.

domains.name: Mental Health Medication
domains.summary: Records whether the child was on medications for mental illness and details about prior and current mental health services received.

domains.name: Mental Health Barriers
domains.summary: Identifies issues preventing the child from receiving mental health services, including specific barriers specified by review teams.

domains.name: Criminal History
domains.summary: Documents if the child had a delinquent or criminal history and specifies types of offenses such as assaults, drugs, robbery, and other crimes.

domains.name: Substance Abuse
domains.summary: Indicates whether the child had a history of substance use or abuse including tobacco/nicotine use.

domains.name: Education Level
domains.summary: Reports the highest level of education attained by the child, with an option to specify if not listed.

domains.name: Employment Status
domains.summary: Describes whether the child was employed and provides details on employment status.

domains.name: Gender Identity
domains.summary: Captures the gender identity of the child, with an option to specify if other than listed categories.
